other_conditions: Applicant must be an unorganized worker
Applicant must have a Samagra ID and Pariwar ID
Applicant or his spouse must not own more than 1 hectare of agricultural land
Applicant must not be in government service
Applicant must not be an income tax payer
Applicant must not have any other social security cover such as Provident Fund, Employees' State Insurance Scheme, or Gratuity
benefits_summary: Provides a funeral grant of ₹5,000 and death/disability benefits ranging from ₹1,00,000 to ₹4,00,000.
